mapper.sql: a.ID AS appealId, a.TASK_ID AS taskId, t.TASK_NO AS taskNo, a.ORDER_ID AS orderId, o.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, a.USER_ID AS userId, u.USER_NAME AS userName, u.USER_PHONE AS userPhoneRaw, a.APPEAL_REASON AS appealReason, a.APPEAL_DESC AS appealDesc, a.RECEIVED_COUNT AS receivedCount, a.APPEAL_STATUS AS appealStatus, a.HANDLE_BY AS handleBy, e.EMPLOYEE_NAME AS handleByName, a.HANDLE_TIME AS handleTime, a.HANDLE_RESULT AS handleResult, a.CREATE_TIME AS createTime
LEFT JOIN ws_delivery_task t ON t.ID = a.TASK_ID LEFT JOIN ws_order o ON o.ID = a.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN ws_user u ON u.ID = a.USER_ID LEFT JOIN api_employee e ON e.ID = a.HANDLE_BY
mapper.select:
SELECT , g.appealCount AS appealCount, g.activeAppealId AS activeAppealId, g.firstAppealTime AS firstAppealTime, g.lastAppealTime AS lastAppealTime FROM ( SELECT s.ID AS repAppealId, s.TASK_ID AS taskId, s.appealCount, s.activeAppealId, s.firstAppealTime, s.lastAppealTime FROM ( SELECT x.ID, x.TASK_ID, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY x.TASK_ID) AS appealCount, MAX(IF(x.APPEAL_STATUS = 1, x.ID, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY x.TASK_ID) AS activeAppealId, MIN(x.CREATE_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY x.TASK_ID) AS firstAppealTime, MAX(x.CREATE_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY x.TASK_ID) AS lastAppealTime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.TASK_ID ORDER BY (x.APPEAL_STATUS = 1) DESC, x.CREATE_TIME DESC, x.ID DESC) AS repRank FROM ws_delivery_appeal x WHERE x.DATA_STATUS = 0 ) s WHERE s.repRank = 1 ) g JOIN ws_delivery_appeal a ON a.ID = g.repAppealId
WHERE a.DATA_STATUS = 0
AND a.APPEAL_STATUS = #{bo.appealStatus}
AND o.ORDER_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.orderNo}, '%')
ORDER BY (g.activeAppealId IS NOT NULL) DESC, g.lastAppealTime DESC, g.taskId DESC
